verdict.rationale: Maritime documents an official CLI, installed with `npm install -g maritime-cli`, for deploying and managing agents from the terminal. It is explicitly built to be operated by AI agents: `--json` output on every command, stable exit codes, a self-describing contract, and non-interactive env-var authentication via `MARITIME_TOKEN`. A probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI actually working as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Maritime CLI lets you deploy and manage agents from your terminal.
The Maritime CLI is built to be operated by other AI agents, not just humans: machine-readable output on every command, stable exit codes, and a live self-describing contract.
Pass --json on EVERY command. Success: one JSON value on stdout, stderr empty.
Authenticate with an env var, never interactively.
